name: NOCIL Ltd
title: NOCIL Ltd - 500730 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 volumes up 7% QoQ to 150 index, but EBITDA margin fell to 6.4% as RM spike and legacy inventory costs squeezed spreads; Rs.130 cr new capacity adds to supply, offset by pending antidumping duties.

capex.peers_comment: Analyst cited a Chinese competitor referring to Indian players putting up capex; management did not directly address it beyond inventory holding capacity.

triggers.label: Realisations under pressure from imports
triggers.quote: realizations continued to be under pressure in the quarter due to the ongoing dumping of lower-priced imports

triggers.label: Price hikes on non-contractual business
triggers.quote: we revised our price upwards for the non-contractual part of our business and from the present quarter for the contractual business

triggers.label: DGTR positive findings on TDQ, Sulphenamides
triggers.quote: recommended positive final findings in respect of the antioxidant TDQ and Sulphenamides covering CBS and NS in March 2026

triggers.label: Q4 margin fell to 6.4%
triggers.quote: EBITDA margins shrinking marginally to 6.4% in Q4 FY '26

guidance.metric: EBITDA margin improvement from FY26 base
guidance.quote: we are looking to improve our EBITDA from the base of financial year '26 by another 150 basis points going forward
we are looking at double-digit growth in terms of volumes, that's the target for the coming years

prior_guidance_check.quote: We expect this positive momentum to sustain in the coming quarters.

red_flags.label: Margin compression with stock-change debit
red_flags.quote: some inventory depletion effect, which is reflected in the stock change effect

red_flags.label: Management missed own profitability and volume metrics
red_flags.quote: we are a bit behind as far as what we have set out to do

evasions.quote: We don't give the specific numbers for business sensitivity.
It's kind of -- it's a dynamic situation, Harshil, yes.

evasions.topic: ADD impact on spreads and peak margins
evasions.quote: it's premature to comment on that
